summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of LEGION OF BOTS. Backend: 53 pytest tests (auth/JWT, bcrypt, lockout path, bots catalog 150, 14 suites, filters/sort/search, bot-instruction isolation via real SSE streaming on 2 personas + prompt-leak attempt, conversation CRUD/persistence, favorites, recent, dashboard, memory, python tool, admin authz, DOCX generation + download + ownership, vision/image chat) — all passed (1 skipped as not applicable). Frontend: landing, UI register, login, dashboard, All Bots (150 cards + search/suite/sort filters), Suites + suite detail, global search overlay, bot workspace streaming chat with markdown, model selector, favorite toggle, conversations page rename/delete, Settings memory add/remove/toggle, admin panel (overview, search, instructions modal, status/feature toggles), logout, mobile drawer — all functional. 3 real issues found (1 HIGH visual leak of the generate-file JSON during streaming, missing admin route guard, admin table 200-row cap).

minor.issue: Returns all 210 bots unpaginated; frontend slices to 200 so 10 bots are unreachable in the admin UI. Add limit/skip or server-side pagination.

Images for non-image-capable bots are silently dropped (no warning event). Also every one of the 150 seeded bots has capabilities.image=true, so image gating is effectively never enforced/verifiable (importer heuristic marks image=true for all).
Brute-force lockout counter is keyed on ip:email and resets on success; correct behaviour observed, but lockout is not surfaced with Retry-After header (minor).

ui_bugs.issue: During/right after streaming, the raw ```generate-file {"format":"docx","filename":...,"content":...}``` block is rendered as a code block in the assistant bubble. The backend strips it before persisting, so it disappears only after page reload. Cause: send() pushes the raw accumulated `acc` into messages instead of the cleaned text. Fix: strip the generate-file fence client-side (or have the backend send the cleaned content in the 'done' SSE event and use it).

No role guard on /admin — a non-admin user who navigates directly to /admin sees the full Admin Dashboard shell (title, empty table) while 3 API calls return 403 that are silently swallowed (.catch(() => {})). Should redirect to /dashboard or show an 'Admin access required' message.
Escape key does not close the modal (only backdrop/X). While open, the fixed overlay intercepts all clicks. Added missing data-testid="admin-modal-close" to the X button.
bots.slice(0, 200) with 210 total bots — last 10 bots cannot be viewed/edited; no pagination control.

issues: Several bot names are raw DOCX titles and read badly, e.g. 'ADD on Document for NEO Matrix - USE in Tandum with' (truncated + typo 'Tandum'), 'Osv5 - Book Writer V5', 'Image Seed Original NO Longer Works'. Consider cleaning names during import.
Multiple near-duplicate 'Book Writer V1..V8' entries (19 bots in Book Writing suite) reduce perceived dedup quality.
No contrast, spacing or overflow problems found at 1920x1080 or 390x844; no horizontal overflow on mobile; mobile drawer works.

action_items: BotWorkspace.send(): do not render the raw generate-file block — strip it from `acc` before pushing the assistant message (or use cleaned text returned in the 'done' event).
Add an admin role guard for the /admin route (redirect or 403 message) instead of rendering the admin shell for non-admins.
Paginate /api/admin/bots + Admin table (currently slice(0,200) hides 10 of 210 bots).
Optionally: close the admin instructions modal on Escape.
Review importer capability heuristics — capabilities.image=true for all 150 bots makes image gating meaningless.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx swallows API errors with .catch(() => {}) — 403/500 leaves the user on a blank table with no feedback; surface an error state.
server.py chat_stream silently drops images for non-image bots; consider returning a warning SSE event so the UI can inform the user.
/api/files/{id}/download depends on `request: Request = None` default for the header-auth fallback; works but is fragile — prefer an explicit Depends(optional_user) plus token fallback.
Bot detail/list responses correctly exclude system_instructions and _id (verified); admin detail correctly includes instructions and is 403-protected for non-admins.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (added data-testid to modal close button only)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; 1 HIGH visual bug, 1 missing route guard, 2 minor admin issues)

seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway users TEST_*@legionqa.com via API and UI (TEST_uirlfdto@legionqa.com); created + deleted TEST_ memories and conversations for testuser@legion.ai; generated DOCX files (TEST_Doc.docx, QA_Doc.docx). testuser memory_enabled restored to true; admin featured/status toggles reverted (150 active bots verified after).
test_credentials: admin@legion.ai / LegionAdmin2026! (role admin, verified) ; testuser@legion.ai / TestUser2026! (verified) — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct slugs: bots 'book-writer', 'time-machine'; suite slugs are business,time-machine,book-writing,science,research,writing,coding,cannabis,movie-creation,agriculture,utility,creative,health,specialized (NOT 'specialist-minds' — that's only the hostname). Run non-AI tests with `pytest tests/ -m 'not chat'` (fast, 5s) and AI tests with `-m chat -n 0` (~30s, consumes LLM credits). SSE helper sse_chat() is in both test files. Frontend E2E already covers auth, dashboard, all bots filters, suites, workspace streaming, model selector, favorites, conversations rename/delete, settings memory, admin panel, mobile drawer. Re-verify: (1) generate-file JSON no longer visible during streaming, (2) /admin blocked for non-admin, (3) admin table pagination.
rca_of_the_issue: Generate-file leak: backend tools.extract_file_request() strips the ```generate-file``` fence before persisting the assistant message, but BotWorkspace.send() appends the raw streamed accumulator `acc` to local state, so the JSON spec is visible until the conversation is re-fetched. Confirmed by reopening the same conversation after reload — the JSON block is absent and only the download button remains. Admin guard: App.js <Protected> only checks authentication; Admin.jsx has no role check and swallows the resulting 403s.
